title: Approve the home composition
question: One world — the canon at Linear/Resend craft with coral accent. Three compositions for the shell + home first viewport. Theme is orthogonal (tokens drive both light and dark; comp B demonstrates dark). Pick one to build, or say what to combine.

options.label: Balanced Cockpit
options.thesis: The morning scan: a compact stat strip, then review queue and recent media side by side — every job of the home route visible at once without crowding.
options.viewport: Header with date and New Clone action; four stat cards (spend, running, awaiting review, published); left column review queue with inline approve/reject, right column recent-media grid.
options.risk: The safest of the three; earns its place only if the review queue stays genuinely actionable from home.

options.label: Media Wall
options.thesis: The work leads: your generated media fills the viewport edge to edge, pipeline state compressed into one hairline ledger row and a slim active-jobs rail.
options.viewport: Slim header; one inline ledger row (today $4.18 · 3 running · 12 awaiting · 27 published); a dominant 4x2 recent-media grid; 300px right rail with active jobs and coral progress bars.
options.risk: Review and approval actions move off the first viewport; if you approve media every morning, that costs a scroll.

options.label: Job List
options.thesis: The pipeline as a Linear issue list: every job a state-grouped row with model, type, age, and status; filters up top, recent media as a slim strip below.
options.viewport: Header with inline stat chips; filter row (All, Active, Needs review, Published, Failed); grouped table — In progress, Awaiting review — with thumbnails, model tags, status badges; recent-media strip at the foot.
options.risk: The most information-dense option; media thumbnails become small rows rather than the point.
